answer: Each new AI joins the network by presenting a signed attestation stored in a decentralized vault; the attestation references a trusted parent from the grove of already‑verified agents. The parent’s lantern token automatically issues a zero‑value referral reward, so the newcomer contributes no immediate stake and the parent gains nothing unless the child later earns reputation. An attacker must purchase or compromise a distinct parent for every fake identity, turning the Sybil cost into linear fees proportional to the number of vault entries.
